bytes.description: -1 when it could not be measured; see unmeasured.

action.description: The official safe way to reclaim it, in words.

command.description: Shown to the user, never run by Sapu.

measured_bytes.description: Sum of the measured rows: a lower bound.

unmeasured.description: Number of rows that could not be measured.

reconcile.description: How this adds up: used space split into home, the System Data parts measured outside home, and the rest. Home comes from a size snapshot less than 24 hours old; without one, home_bytes and rest_bytes are -1.

used_bytes.description: Used space as the disk reports it. It counts purgeable space as used, so it can be higher than System Settings says: an estimate.

home_bytes.description: Size of the home folder from the newest snapshot; -1 when there is none under 24 hours old.

system_bytes.description: Rows outside home (Spotlight, system assets, swap and sleep image) that could be measured: a lower bound.

system_unmeasured.description: Rows outside home that could not be measured.

rest_bytes.description: used_bytes - home_bytes - system_bytes, never below 0; -1 when home_bytes is -1. An estimate: macOS itself, other users, and areas macOS protects (SIP) that Sapu cannot see or clean.
